entries.title: Models whose strongest reasoning is Max offer Max
entries.body: Some models, such as GLM-5.3, offer Max reasoning above High, and some offer it above Extra high. Models now lists Max beside a model's other reasoning choices when the model offers it, and crewmates on that model can work at it. Before, those models stopped at High or Extra high.
entries.noPicture: The change adds one choice to an existing menu; the menu and the Models view otherwise look the same.
